test: BDC spread/event-driven frontrun backtest (Arm-A properly-powered), PILOT_SPEC §1/§4/§6/§7, amendments A-1/A-2/A-4/A-5

mechanism.masking_channel: quarterly printed NAV with ~30-45d 10-Q filing lag; market trades on stale prior-quarter NAV during lag
mechanism.signal_channel: derived NAV = re-mark last-printed floating-rate loan book for the HY-OAS credit-spread move (prior print -> quarter-end), models the OFFICIAL mark (smoothing 0.5, spread-duration 2.5y)
mechanism.signal_to_price_latency: NONE capturable: BDC price reprices contemporaneously with the spread move, and at no greater rate than zero-credit equity CEFs (generic risk-off), so no spread-driven lag to frontrun

panel.window: 2023-Q3 .. 2026-Q1 (NAV/holdings from primary 10-Q/10-K inline XBRL); spread FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 2023-06..2026-06

gate_amendment_logged.why: a 5% NAV move on a ~100%-L3 floating-rate book needs ~400bp of quarter-end spread move at smoothing0.5/dur2.5; largest QoQ HY-OAS move in 3yr was ~63bp -> locked gate is unreachable on the credit channel ex a GFC-scale event
gate_amendment_logged.note: scaled gate is a LABELED SECONDARY; the locked test is preserved and reported

c_convergence_and_pnl.finding: no capturable convergence: BDC price moves contemporaneously with spread (already priced), so the lag window holds no spread-driven gap to capture
c_convergence_and_pnl.borrow_bidask: moot (no edge); liquidity fine (ARCC b/a ~0.2%, PSEC ~0.4%); BDCs generally shortable but trade at discounts (long-side), no squeeze flag

edge_A_minus_B.edge_bdc: NULL at honest N: 7/11 quarter-directions (63.6%), sign-test p=0.55, placebo 78th pctile, magnitude R^2=0.03
edge_A_minus_B.edge_control_ADX_USA: zero by construction (daily NAV, no filing-lag NAV)
edge_A_minus_B.confound_check: BDC price-vs-spread corr (ARCC -0.66, MAIN -0.70) does NOT exceed control CEFs (ADX -0.68, USA -0.82) -> the spread->price link is generic RISK-OFF beta, not a BDC-NAV computation edge

power_caveat: 2023-26 spreads were quiet: max QoQ HY-OAS move ~63bp; the famous Apr-2025 tariff spike (4.61) round-tripped to 2.96 by quarter-end so it never hit a printed mark. Effective independent N ~11 quarters. Low power to detect a credit-channel edge AND no edge detected.
confound_caveat: idiosyncratic per-name credit marks (defaults/write-downs: PSEC -9.5%/qtr, FSK -6.2%/qtr) dominate the quarterly NAV move and are invisible to a broad spread index -> the spread channel is not where BDC NAV moves come from.
verdict: §7 FAILED. The aggregation/timing MOAT is real (quarterly lagged NAV, no continuous mark) but the spread-driven frontrun edge collapses to "moat real but already priced": the discount reprices with credit in real time and no faster than zero-credit equity CEFs, so edge(BDC)-edge(control) is not positive. Negative result is the finding.
